exposure: DNA methylation levels of melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) and hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha (HNF4a)
outcome: Metabolic profiles (specifically triglyceride levels) in cord blood
mRNA expression levels of MC4R and HNF4a in cord blood cells
cohort: The study included 85 term infants and 85 preterm infants.
finding: DNA methylation levels of MC4R-CpG3 and HNF4a-CpG2 in the P1 promoter were significantly lower in preterm infants in the high-triglyceride (TG) group compared with mid-and low-TG groups, and preterm infants in the high-TG group had higher cord blood TG levels than term infants in the high-TG group.
cross-section timing: At birth, using cord blood samples.
gest_age: Infants were categorized as term or preterm.
